summary: Tennis tournament Tennis tournament 2022 Berkeley Tennis Club Challenge Date 19–25 September 2022 Edition 4th Category ITF Women's World Tennis Tour Prize money $60,000 Surface Hard / Outdoor Location Berkeley, California , United States Champions Singles Madison Brengle Doubles Elvina Kalieva / Peyton Stearns ← 2021 · Berkeley Tennis Club Challenge · 2023 → The 2022 Berkeley Tennis Club Challenge was a professional tennis tournament played on outdoor hard courts . It was the fourth edition of the tournament which was part of the 2022 ITF Women's World Tennis Tour . It took place in Berkeley, California , United States between 19 and 25 September 2022.
